finding: P1 overwrite consent was bound only to path existence and could overwrite a replacement created while consent was visible.
scope: Only src/ui/games/save.rs production helper and appended tests in src/ui/games/play.rs changed. games.rs/session_confirmations.rs remain exact previously reviewed hashes. No MAIN, backend, game-rule or application identity changes.
identity: Private package0.1.917 / normal bin termcraft-game-save-ui917; original four reviewed candidate files preserved at fix1/base.
fix: Before consent, open the existing regular file without following links and keep its handle alive. Capture device/inode identity (Windows volume/file-index via cap_fs_ext::MetadataExt), length, modification timestamp and <=262144 original content bytes. Revalidate current path/held original identity and bounded contents after consent and again after staging+sync immediately before publication. Changed/replaced/missing/linked targets fail with a readable message, leaving the destination and active game/history/dirty state intact.
bounded_io: Snapshot and each revalidation use MAX_BYTES+1 bounded reads, reject metadata or observed lengths beyond MAX_BYTES, and reject nonregular files. Oversized existing targets fail clearly and require a different save destination. New-target atomic no-clobber hard-link path and anchored same-directory staging/rename remain.
portable_limit: A residual interval remains between the final identity/content checks and portable rename. This implementation does not claim atomic compare-and-swap. Consent-window mutations completed before validation are rejected; the reviewed deterministic replacement and restored-timestamp in-place edit cases pass.
